mechanism.claim: A same-session acceleration or cooling shared by VIX and both the 9D/VIX and VIX/3M log slopes identifies a scale-free volatility shock transition: joint acceleration transmits risk-off pressure to BTC (short), while joint cooling transmits relief (long) for 24 elapsed hours.
mechanism.long: delta log(VIX)<0, delta log(VIX9D/VIX)<0, and delta log(VIX/VIX3M)<0
mechanism.why_distinct: CVACR requires three-way signed acceleration including the VIX level change and has no absolute volatility-level gate. CVCIR used an elevated ranked VIX state and only two curve deltas; CVSRC used static outer levels.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: an official Cboe next-session three-way volatility-acceleration clock is external to BTC activity and absent from Gross9

features.deltas: current minus immediately previous exact common source observation; no calendar fill

clock.trigger: false-to-true onset of each same-sign impulse state; direct switch from opposite state is a new onset
clock.entry: first later exact common Cboe source date at 09:35 America/New_York
clock.reservation: global half-open, entry equal to prior exit accepted

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, sign, hold, or subset repair.
